نلذ (form I)
# نَلَذُّ (nalaḏḏu) /na.lað.ðu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of لَذَّ (laḏḏa)
# نُلَذُّ (nulaḏḏu) /nu.lað.ðu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of لَذَّ (laḏḏa)
# نَلَذَّ (nalaḏḏa) /na.lað.ða/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of لَذَّ (laḏḏa)
# نُلَذَّ (nulaḏḏa) /nu.lað.ða/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive/juss
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
